data.name: Kristine
data.gender_notes: Kristine is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'Christos' (anointed) and 'ine' (woman). The name Kristine symbolizes dedication to the Christian faith, and its roots trace back to the earliest days of Christianity. The name Kristine carries the meaning “Follower of Christ” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kristine usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of christ and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: קריסטינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קריסטינה היא שם נשים יהודי/נוצרי, שמקורו בלטינית, ומשמעותו היא 'בת ישראל', 'נשים חזקות' ו'קריסטוס', האל, המשיח. במסורת הנוצרית, השם קריסטינה נוצר כבר בימי הביניים, ומשמעותו הייתה 'משרתת האל', 'בת ישראל'.

in_greek.name: Κριστίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο τίτλος Κριστίνη, είναι ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος Κριστίνα, που προέρχεται από το ελληνικό όνομα Κριστίνα, και περιέχει τα συστατικά Κριστό και Ίνη, τα οποία σημαίνουν 'χριστός' και 'γυναίκα', αντίστοιχα. Στην παλαιοχριστιανική εποχή, ο τίτλος Κριστίνη χρησιμοποιήθηκε για να περιγράψει μια γυναίκα που ακολουθούσε το χριστιανισμό, και που ήταν μια πιστή προστάτιδα της Εκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Kristina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Kristina est nomen femininum Latinum, quod significat 'filia Christi' vel 'Christi serva'. In Ecclesia Christiana, nomen Kristina usus est ab initio, et significatio eius erat 'mulier Christi', 'serva Christi'.

in_english.name: Kristine
in_english.meaning: Christian, follower of Christ, feminine form of Christopher
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kristine is a feminine form of the name Christopher, which means 'bearing Christ' or 'Christ-bearer'. In Christian tradition, the name Kristine is derived from the Greek name Christos, meaning 'anointed one' or 'Messiah'. The name has its roots in the Latin name Christina, which was used in early Christianity to signify a female follower of Christ. Kristine is a popular name in many Christian cultures, symbolizing faith, devotion, and spiritual strength.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kristine has a rich cultural history, particularly among Christian communities around the world. It is a reminder of the sacramental anointing offered to believers and the significant role of women in the faith.
data.spiritual_significance: Carrying the name Kristine holds a deep spiritual meaning for many Christians. The name reflects a profound sense of faith and devotion, reminding the bearer of their connection to the divine. It is a constant reminder to live a life centered on the teachings of Christ and to strive towards holiness and righteousness. The name Kristine embodies the spiritual qualities of love, peace, and compassion, urging those who bear it to be a beacon of light in the world.
